tally.citation: The epic builds the agentic engine's `_run_plan_review` dispatch and promises identical verdict contracts across engines (Invariants: 'Both engines produce the same verdict contract'; ADR 0123 deliverable), and the bug is that the agentic branch skips the drift floor and xcheck tail that rewrite `verdict["blocking"]`.
tally.title: Agentic verdicts skip drift floor and cross-checks

tally.citation: Epic Goal 3 and the model-upgrade AC ('upgrade every configured model', 'model-call audit') claim all model references moved to 5.5; the bug reports `chunk_by_facet` in plan_review/registry.py still defaulting to claude-sonnet-4-6, which the upgrade missed.
tally.title: Old-generation model ids in src/rebar defaults

tally.citation: Epic's agentic engine deliverable (agentic_verdict.py adapt_findings / agentic_review step in plan-review.yaml) builds the PASS from findings alone with no tool-call check, violating the epic's Fail-closed invariant that only a clean, completed run with schema-valid output yields PASS.
tally.title: Agentic plan review signs a PASS with zero tool calls

tally.citation: Model-upgrade AC claims the provider-parity and prompt evals pass on Opus/Sonnet 5.5, and the epic's before/after prompt evals cover plan-review specs; this bug reports those plan-review prompt evals failing on the 5.5 run with a REVIEW_RESULT schema error.
tally.title: Prompt evals: plan-review criterion specs fail with "'dimension' is a required property" schema error

tally.citation: Same prompt-eval harness the epic's 'prompt evals pass on the new models' AC and the spec model-pin child ticket touch, but the bug is a missing solver branch in eval_solver.py for three pre-existing plan-review specs, which the epic never claimed to add.
tally.title: Live prompt-eval loop has no solver for plan-review-container, -finder and -isf-finder specs (coverage 0.00)

tally.citation: The bug is in the provider_parity harness's tracker resolution (gate_source.gate_read_root, provider_parity.py:355), which the epic's AC names as a verification tool but does not change; the defect is pre-existing and adjacent to the AC claim that provider-parity evals pass on 5.5 models.
tally.title: provider_parity harness fails in a fresh worktree until a CLI call attaches .tickets-tracker

tally.citation: The bug is in the Bedrock spend-cap Lambda/Terraform ceiling table, which the epic never changed or claimed; it is adjacent to the epic's 5.5 model-id upgrade (child 'Bedrock cache-ratio and unit-cost alarms ... still watch the 4.x model ids'), but the AC only names rebar.toml, bedrock.toml and MODEL_WINDOW_LADDER.
tally.title: Bedrock spend-cap metered estimate ran about 3x settled billing on 2026-11-12, above the README's documented band

tally.citation: Bug concerns release-tag type in docs/releasing.md vs release.yml github_release job; the epic covers plan-review engine selection, model upgrade to Opus/Sonnet/Haiku 5.5, and attestation/MCP surfaces, with no claim touching release tagging or the tag-signing section.
tally.title: docs/releasing.md says release tags are annotated, but release.yml creates lightweight tags (v0.13.1, v0.14.0, v0.15.0)
